The '''Falador Diary''' is an [[Achievement Diary]] whose tasks revolve around areas in and near [[Falador]], such as [[Burthorpe]], [[Rimmington]], and [[Taverley]].

Several skill, quest, and item requirements are needed to complete all tasks. Unless stated otherwise, [[temporary skill boost]]s can be used to meet the skill requirements. For the [[#Elite|elite tier]] of this diary, the player must have completed all [[quest]]s, or achieved [[level 99]] in any skill.

Rewards can be claimed from [[Sir Rebral]] in the [[White Knights' Castle]]'s courtyard in [[Falador]]. Tasks may be done in any order, but the previous tiers of a diary must be completed to claim rewards of the next tier.
